Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nFight your way through here - we'll contact you later with further information.\nAnd watch out for those snipers!
Translation: Sven Viking (电台)：\n奋力杀出这里——我们会稍后联系你并提供更多信息。\n小心那些狙击手！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sniper:\nAn airstrike is coming to clear that fortification,\ntry keeping close to the canyonside until it is done!
Translation: Sniper：\n空袭即将来临以清除那座堡垒，\n尽量靠近峡谷边缘直到空袭结束！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Soctom (radio):\nAir support on the way!
Translation: Soctom (电台)：\n空中支援正在路上！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Rusty (radio):\nWe can't support you any further,\nthere are AA batteries locking on us, you are on your own!
Translation: Rusty (电台)：\n我们无法再支援你了，\n有防空炮在锁定我们，你只能靠自己了！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nRadar pictures show a strong fortification ahead.\nTry to find some alternative passage to shoot the tanks from above.
Translation: Sven Viking (电台)：\n雷达图像显示前方有坚固的防御工事。\n尝试寻找其他通道从上方攻击坦克。
